description: Brønnøysund identity slice for a Norwegian organisation: legal name, form of organisation, NACE codes, municipality, registration_date, and the signaturrett / prokura roles (names and role codes from the public register; never fødselsnummer or other national identifiers). Identity ONLY, no verdict on obligations; add get_company_obligations or get_company_deadlines for the regulatory layer. Failure modes: NOT_FOUND, ENTITY_REMOVED, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:brreg` can't see the tool (tools/list leaves it out). For an obligations verdict, use get_company_summary instead; for NACE descriptions, use get_company_profile instead. No API key? Use Bearer apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> (a fresh suffix) to get fixtures; valid orgs are the 818, 99966 and 99977 series and 999000002 (see GET /api/v1/sandbox/fixtures). Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/company-snapshot
description_nb: Hent Brønnøysund-identitetsdelen for en virksomhet: navn, organisasjonsform, NACE-koder, kommune, registreringsdato og rollene (navn og rollekoder fra det offentlige registeret, aldri fødselsnummer). Uten etterlevelsesverdikt. For en etterlevelsesvurdering, bruk get_company_summary i stedet; for profilen med NACE-beskrivelser, bruk get_company_profile i stedet. Krever read:brreg. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund ID); MOD-11-checked up-front — a failing value is rejected as VALIDATION_FAILED, so correct the number rather than retrying it.
